summary: BE - Incorrect Payment Amount Displayed When Invoice Is Paid Using Credit Balance
reported_issue: When an invoice is paid using a customer's existing credit balance, the Payment entry shows the remaining credit instead of the invoice amount actually applied. Example: $10.00 invoice paid from a $14.18 credit balance recorded the payment as $4.18 (the remaining credit) rather than $10.00.
expected_after_fix: The Payment row should show $10.00 (the invoice amount paid); the remaining credit ($4.18) should stay on the account as credit.
steps_i_followed: Identified the required scenario: a customer with an existing credit balance, an unpaid invoice, then apply the credit as payment and inspect the recorded Payment amount.
Assessed the setup: needs a customer credit balance + an invoice + a credit-balance payment application through Customers -> Payments.
actual_now: Not verified within this session. The reproduction requires building a credit-balance-payment scenario (customer credit balance + unpaid invoice + apply credit) and reading back the recorded payment amount; this multi-step setup was not completed before the tool-budget cutoff for this batch. No determination of the payment-amount calculation was made.
notes: Not tested due to batch tool-budget exhaustion after completing higher-feasibility tickets.
